title: Regression: Incremental rebuild broken for signed images
author: jusherma
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Previous Working Version

202505

### Steps to Reproduce

In 202505 and earlier, incremental rebuild of the final sonic.bin file was possible, which enabled very fast build of multiple images with slightly different build flags. For example, building ZTP and non-ZTP images in the same workspace was possible with only a few extra minutes of build time:

```
make init
make configure
make ENABLE_ZTP=y all
mv target/sonic.bin target/sonic.ztp.bin
make ENABLE_ZTP=n all # This step only takes 10 minutes because only .bin repackaging happens
```

From 202511 onwards, this functionality is broken when image signing is also performed, as the `sign-file` kernel script is missing from the sonic-slave docker _container_ on the second bin build only. 

This appears to be due to the lack of the linux-kbuild package in the sonic-slave-trixie docker _image_.

Prior to trixie, the linux-kbuild package, which provides the `sign-file` utility, was installed into the sonic-slave docker _image_ directly by the `sonic-slave-*/Dockerfile.j2` files:

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/8e65b0854512fde4be8afd4737bf69a48b05565e/sonic-slave-bookworm/Dockerfile.j2#L238

However, the linux-kbuild install is missing from `sonic-slave-trixie/Dockerfile.j2`.

Instead, the linux-kbuild package is installed into the sonic-slave-trixie _container_ during the build process, specifically in by the build_debian.sh script during the creation of the `sonic-<PLATFORM>.bin__<PLATFORM>__rfs.squashfs` target:

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/8e65b0854512fde4be8afd4737bf69a48b05565e/build_debian.sh#L168-L169

This works fine for the first build. But, when building a second .bin file with slightly different flags (e.g. disabling ZTP), the rfs.squashfs target is not rebuilt, so the linux-kbuild package is never installed into the sonic-slave-trixie container. 

Then, when the image signing logic is invoked during the second bin generation, the requisite `sign-file` binary is not present in the container, causing the build to fail:

```
ERROR: LOCAL_SIGN_FILE=/usr/lib/linux-kbuild-6.12.41+deb13/scripts/sign-file file does not exist
```

I see a few potential ways to resolve this:

1. Install the linux-kbuild package in the sonic-slave-trixie docker _image_, if possible
2. Add logic in the .bin generation step to install linux-kbuild into the sonic-slave container
3. Force the rfs.squashfs target to rebuild when a new bin file is generated, or at least confirm the lack of squashfs rebuild is intentional (rather than due to a missing dependency)

### Impact of this regression

Incremental rebuild of the .bin file is not possible when image signing is needed as well. This substantially increases build time when producing, for example, ZTP and non-ZTP images from the same sources

comments.author: saiarcot895
comments.body:
This was an intentional change that we did; since we are building our own kernel, we want to make sure the kbuild package that gets used is from the version that we build. There have also been a few cases in the past where the kernel version couldn't be updated because the Debian snapshot mirror that we use didn't have a sufficiently updated version of the linux-kbuild package.

The kbuild package that we build can be installed by adding a dependency to the `$(SONIC_INSTALLERS)` target in `slave.mk`, specifically, by adding `$(addprefix $(IMAGE_DISTRO_DEBS_PATH)/,$(LINUX_KBUILD)-install)`. This might be better than having it get installed in `build_debian.sh`, since this will be recorded as a dependency.

linkedPullRequests.title: [slave.mk]: Add linux-kbuild install dependency to installer target
linkedPullRequests.author: Bojun-Feng
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/26483

Currently, the `linux-kbuild` package (which provides the `sign-file` utility) is only installed into the sonic-slave container during the `rfs.squashfs` build step in `build_debian.sh`.

On incremental rebuilds, the `rfs.squashfs` target is not rebuilt, so `linux-kbuild` is never re-installed into the container, causing the signing step to fail with `ERROR: LOCAL_SIGN_FILE=... file does not exist`.

#### How I did it
* Added `$(LINUX_KBUILD)-install` as a dependency to the `$(SONIC_INSTALLERS)` target in `slave.mk`
* This ensures the `linux-kbuild` package is installed into the sonic-slave container before `.bin` generation, regardless of whether the `rfs.squashfs` target was rebuilt
* This approach was suggested by @saiarcot895 as the preferred fix, since it records the dependency explicitly in make rather than relying on a side effect of the squashfs build step

#### How to verify it
1. Build a signed image: `make ENABLE_ZTP=y all`
2. Move the output: `mv target/sonic.bin target/sonic.ztp.bin`
3. Build again with different flags: `make ENABLE_ZTP=n all`
4. Verify the second build completes without `sign-file` errors

#### Description for the changelog
* Fixed incremental rebuild failure for signed images by adding linux-kbuild install dependency to the installer target

Update: Re-run build locally, verified that the `kbuild` package is indeed rebuilt on incremental rebuilds. Unfortunately I made new clones and forgot to enable signing on them, but now we know the fix works at the dependency level.

<details>
<summary>More Details</summary>

### Setup

Run these in two different directories
```
# Master head on 03/31/2026
git clone https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage
git checkout b9d726a3710da24b605353359fa891b3b6375e1e 

# This PR, exactly one commit ahead of commit above
git clone https://github.com/Bojun-Feng/sonic-buildimage
git checkout bug/fix-incremental-rebuild-kbuild
git checkout 8c4302591ea58c256e2219fbfccd21d628292481
```

### Commands

Run the same commands in both clones
```
git submodule update --init --recursive

make init &&  \
make configure \
  PLATFORM=vs

# By default ENABLE_ZTP=n
make \
  SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 \
  SONIC_BUILD_RETRY_COUNT=1 \
  target/sonic-vs.img.gz

# Remove artifact, rebuild with ENABLE_ZTP=y
mv ./target/sonic-vs.img.gz ./target/sonic-vs.noztp.img.gz

make \
  SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 \
  SONIC_BUILD_RETRY_COUNT=1 \
  ENABLE_ZTP=y \
  target/sonic-vs.img.gz
```

In master on rebuild:
```
[ 01 ] [ target/debs/trixie/sonic-ztp_1.0.0_all.deb ]
[ 01 ] [ target/sonic-vs.img.gz ]
```

In PR on rebuild:
```
[ 01 ] [ target/debs/trixie/sonic-ztp_1.0.0_all.deb ]
[ 02 ] [ target/debs/trixie/linux-kbuild-6.12.41+deb13_6.12.41-1_amd64.deb-install ]
[ 01 ] [ target/sonic-vs.img.gz ]
```
</details>

I'm removing the `apt install linux-kbuild` now. Will make a new clone and build again with signing enabled to ensure this PR fixes the `sign-file` issue.

comments.author: Bojun-Feng
comments.body:
Update: Successfully reproduced issue locally. Incremental build on PR completes normally as expected.

<details>
<summary>More Details</summary>

### Setup

Run these in two different directories
```
# Master head on 03/31/2026
git clone https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage
git checkout b9d726a3710da24b605353359fa891b3b6375e1e 

# This PR, exactly two commit ahead of commit above
git clone https://github.com/Bojun-Feng/sonic-buildimage
git checkout bug/fix-incremental-rebuild-kbuild
git checkout 418afa1205cb5f51f61c3e5cf51237227ff40ef6

# Run this once, you may want to change the path
openssl req -new -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout /home/ubuntu/temp1/dev-signing-key.pem -out /home/ubuntu/temp1/dev-signing-cert.pem -days 365 -nodes -subj "/CN=SONiC Dev Signing Key"
```

### Commands

Run the same commands in both clones
```
git submodule update --init --recursive

# Enable signing, again you may want to change the path
echo 'SECURE_UPGRADE_MODE = dev
SECURE_UPGRADE_DEV_SIGNING_KEY = /home/ubuntu/temp1/dev-signing-key.pem
SECURE_UPGRADE_SIGNING_CERT = /home/ubuntu/temp1/dev-signing-cert.pem' >> ./rules/config.user

make init &&  \
make configure \
  PLATFORM=vs

# By default ENABLE_ZTP=n
make \
  SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 \
  SONIC_BUILD_RETRY_COUNT=1 \
  target/sonic-vs.img.gz

# Remove artifact, rebuild with ENABLE_ZTP=y
mv ./target/sonic-vs.img.gz ./target/sonic-vs.noztp.img.gz

make \
  SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 \
  SONIC_BUILD_RETRY_COUNT=1 \
  ENABLE_ZTP=y \
  target/sonic-vs.img.gz
```

In master on rebuild:
```
[ 01 ] [ target/debs/trixie/sonic-ztp_1.0.0_all.deb ]
[ 01 ] [ target/sonic-vs.img.gz ]

[ FAIL LOG START ] [ target/sonic-vs.img.gz ]
...
ERROR: LOCAL_SIGN_FILE=/usr/lib/linux-kbuild-6.12.41+deb13/scripts/sign-file file does not exist
./scripts/signing_kernel_modules.sh: # Display Help
./scripts/signing_kernel_modules.sh -l <LINUX_KERNEL_VERSION> -c <PEM_CERT> -p <PEM_PRIVATE_KEY> -s <LOCAL_SIGN_FILE> -e <LOCAL_EXTRACT_CERT> -k <KERNEL_MODULES_DIR>
Sign kernel modules in <KERNEL_MODULES_DIR> using private & public keys.

Parameters description:
LINUX_KERNEL_VERSION
PEM_CERT                             public key (pem format)
PEM_PRIVATE_KEY                      private key (pem format)
LOCAL_SIGN_FILE                      path of the sign-file tool for signing Kernel Modules, if the value is empty it will used the sign-file installed in /usr/lib/linux-kbuild-<version>/scripts
LOCAL_EXTRACT_CERT                   path of the extract-cert tool for Extract X.509 certificate, if the value is empty it will used the extract-cert installed in /usr/lib/linux-kbuild-<version>/scripts
KERNEL_MODULES_DIR                   root directory of all the kernel modules to be sign by the script, if the value empty it will use the call script location as root.

Runs examples:
1. ./scripts/signing_kernel_modules.sh -l 5.10.0-8-2 -c cert.pem -p priv-key.pem
2. ./scripts/signing_kernel_modules.sh -l 5.10.0-8-2 -c cert.pem -p priv-key.pem -k fsroot-mellanox -e /usr/lib/linux-kbuild-5.10/scripts/extract-cert -s /usr/lib/linux-kbuild-5.10/scripts/sign-file
+ sudo LANG=C chroot ./fsroot-vs umount /proc
+ true
[  FAIL LOG END  ] [ target/sonic-vs.img.gz ]
```
